description:
[Merchant] Get details of a specific POI (Point of Interaction).

**Authentication:** your own JWT (an ISV makes the same call on your behalf).
**Endpoint:** GET /poi/{poiId}
**Use Case:** Retrieve full details of a physical payment point including configuration and current state.

**Required:** POI ID.

poiId.description: The POI identifier (format: pi + 8 alphanumeric chars, e.g., piABC12345)

name: payware_poi_get
